have h_main : multiply_postcond (a) (b) (multiply (a) (b) h_precond) h_precond := by
    dsimp [multiply_postcond, multiply_precond, multiply] at *
    <;>
    (try simp_all) <;>
    (try ring_nf) <;>
    (try constructor <;> ring_nf <;> norm_num) <;>
    (try omega) <;>
    (try aesop) <;>
    (try
      {
        norm_num
        <;>
        ring_nf
        <;>
        simp_all [sub_eq_add_neg]
        <;>
        omega
      })
    <;>
    aesop

  exact h_main
